# Shared vectors for the Site Cache page model (internal/webui/static/assets/webdet/site-cache-model.js).
# One case per line, TAB-separated: <kind>	<input>	<expected>. <empty> is the empty string.
# Read by three tests, so the page cannot drift from what it mirrors:
#   ttl, host, cookie, cookieq - internal/webdetector/site_cache_ui_parity_test.go (the daemon);
#   bucket            - scripts/tests/cfm_cache_ui_parity_test.lua (the edge);
#   all of them       - site-cache-model.test.js (the page).
#
# ttl: parseCacheTTL -> seconds, or invalid.
ttl	5s	5
ttl	1m	60
ttl	2h	7200
ttl	7d	604800
ttl	+30s	30
ttl	05s	5
ttl	5S	5
ttl	 10s 	10
ttl	0s	invalid
ttl	-5s	invalid
ttl	5	invalid
ttl	s	invalid
ttl	5 s	invalid
ttl	5x	invalid
ttl	1.5s	invalid
ttl	99999999999999999999s	invalid
ttl	<empty>	invalid
#
# bucket: the micro TTL the edge snaps a stored TTL to (cfm_cache.lua micro_bucket_seconds).
bucket	1s	1
bucket	2s	2
bucket	3s	2
bucket	4s	5
bucket	7s	5
bucket	8s	10
bucket	20s	10
bucket	45s	30
bucket	46s	60
bucket	1m	60
bucket	2h	60
bucket	1d	60
bucket	+5s	5
bucket	5	5
bucket	5 s	5
bucket	5x	1
bucket	0s	1
bucket	-5s	1
bucket	garbage	1
bucket	<empty>	1
#
# host: the set API accepts the host (ok) or refuses it (bad).
host	shop.example.com	ok
host	Shop.Example.COM.	ok
host	*.example.com	ok
host	a_b.example.com	ok
host	xn--bcher-kva.example	ok
host	localhost	ok
host	*.com	bad
host	*.	bad
host	a..b	bad
host	.example.com	bad
host	-a.example.com	bad
host	a-.example.com	bad
host	a b.example.com	bad
host	*.*.example.com	bad
host	a*.example.com	bad
host	example.com:443	bad
host	bücher.example	bad
host	aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.example.com	bad
host	<empty>	bad
host	aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.example.com	ok
host	aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb.ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc.ddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd	ok
host	aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb.ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc.ddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddde	bad
host	*.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb.ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc.ddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd	ok
host	*.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb.ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc.ddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddde	bad

cookie	myapp_session	ok
cookie	cart[id]	ok
cookie	__Host-PHPSESSID	ok
cookie	"quoted"	ok
cookie	a=b	bad
cookie	a;b	bad
cookie	a b	bad

cookie	__secure-	bad
cookie	[x	bad

#
# cookieq: a cookie case written with \uXXXX escapes (the Go and JS readers decode them), so
# no invisible character sits in this file. Go's unicode.IsSpace, not JavaScript's \s.
cookieq	a\u3000b	bad
cookieq	a\u0085b	bad
cookieq	a\u2028b	bad
cookieq	a\u00a0b	bad
cookieq	a\u2007b	bad
cookieq	a\ufeffb	ok
cookieq	a\u200bb	ok
cookieq	\u212a	ok
